method: Mean of two per-run medians; alternating before/after/after/before; real SDK 0.84.1; Node v26.7.0
notes: The unchanged-input prompt microbenchmark increases from 0.000295 to 0.008281 ms (about 8 microseconds): current cache validation checks task content and appends current usage, while v0.30.5 trusts its revision/time-based key. This is below the existing 0.015 ms short-path allowance; no release-level prompt speedup is claimed.
Activity measurement includes the warm ledger/index lookup and latest-five item formatting; full ledger parsing and initial indexing occur before timing.
Expanded dashboard uses 50 long tasks, a long objective and width 120; text metrics/wrapping use the real SDK.
